Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — Shares the latest job report, noting unemployment edged down to 7.2%, a mix of relief and concern for the economy.

• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make it feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! Thanks for sharing your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction — I like that it keeps things simple and personal, and having your email right there makes it easy for people to reach out. A couple of suggestions if you'd like to make it even more engaging: adding a short bio or a few interests/hobbies, plus some links to your other profiles or projects, would give visitors a bit more to explore. Great start though — wishing you lots of visitors!

Hi Eve! Thanks for sharing your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I like the personal touch — mentioning that hiking is your favorite hobby gives readers an immediate sense of who you are and what your blog is about. If you'd like to grow it, adding a few recent post entries, some photos from your hikes, and a short "About Me" section would make the blog feel much more alive and give readers a reason to come back. A lovely concept — I'd love to read more about your hiking adventures!
